metadata.name: Rumi DevOps Release Pack
metadata.description: Declarative local-first DevOps and release operations pack for CI triage, release evidence, runbooks, rollback plans, GitHub Actions, and Cloudflare Workers-aware operations.
metadata.author: Rumi AI Team

depends_on.reason: Uses defaultspack agent, prompt, audit, local file, terminal, and profile conventions.
References existing file, git, terminal, browser companion, and web research tool families without redefining them.

optional_integrations.reason: Code pack owns source edits; this pack owns operational gates, release evidence, runbooks, and rollback plans.
Agent services pack owns service agent topology; this pack owns release and incident evidence around those services.

allowed_when_explicitly_requested: user asks to inspect remote CI or deployment state
user provides an approved authenticated connector or local log export
release runbook requires current platform documentation
